themes.name: Blossom
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Dantotsu look: pure black and pink, a profile banner with hub cards, ★ cover rails, bottom series tabs.

themes.name: Booth
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Miruro look: near-black and lavender in Geist, a card hero with a gradient title, a tabbed grid and a Top Airing aside.

themes.name: Carbon
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Anime Nexus look: zinc in DM Sans, a centred logo, a light Watch now, corner-badged episodes, a popular list.

themes.name: Cobalt
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: A tracker-style navy canvas with a sky-blue accent and square corners. The stock featured banner keeps its rank badge, poster rows carry grey captions, and the series page stacks a muted facts panel — format, episodes, season, studio, source — beside the cover, with episodes in a still grid.

themes.name: Coral
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Zangetsu look: near-black and coral, a glowing card hero, ★ poster rails, a floating dock, full-bleed series header.

themes.name: Daylight
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: The catalog’s light theme. A warm paper canvas, serif type and a coral accent. Top navigation, a featured backdrop with a paper caption card and an ink-dark Watch button, generously rounded poster rows with titles and years, and a split series page with a right-hand episode rail.

themes.name: Ember
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: A warm crimson living-room palette: tinted cards, a red accent, landscape resume art and the same split episode rail as Tidal.

themes.name: Frost
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: MKissa look: pure black in Inter, a labelled side rail, big poster cards with episode footers, orange ranks.

themes.name: Halo
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Frosted chrome: a top navigation bar, aurora glass, large landscape tiles and quiet poster titles. The seekbar uses the brand accent.

themes.name: Iris
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Senshi look: near-black and purple, a full-bleed hero under a clear header, overlay poster rails, medal-ranked trending.

themes.name: Kindling
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Cool gray canvas, rose accent, Nunito. Home opens on a rotating full-bleed featured banner with Watch Now and View Details, then horizontal poster rows. The series page uses icon facts, an overlapping cover, and a right-hand rail with one short episode tile per row — square still on the left, title and synopsis on the right, grow-on-hover. Phones get a shorter banner, tighter rows and a stacked series page with the same episode tiles.

themes.name: Lavender
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: anilili look: black and purple, genre chips over a full-bleed hero, segmented tabs, ★ score badges, pill tabs.

themes.name: Ledger
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Near-black media-server look with a violet accent. Home uses a continue-watching banner, large 16:9 resume stills, then poster carousels beside an icon sidebar. The series page is a tall fluid banner, overlapping cover on the left, metadata, and a grid of episode stills below.

themes.name: Marigold
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: KickAssAnime look: black and Material yellow in Roboto, a pinned side menu, year-chip poster grid, today's releases.

themes.name: Marquee
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Netflix look: #141414 and red in Inter, an inset rounded billboard with a muted trailer, 16:9 logo cards that grow into a preview on hover, a ranked row and a centred title panel. On a TV or in Game mode: a pill top bar, tall boxart rows anchored to the first column and a grid search keyboard.

themes.name: Nebula
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: A deep violet-navy canvas with a soft mesh glow and a bright violet accent. Compact icon rail, a wide featured backdrop with pill actions, rounded poster rows with quiet titles, and a full-bleed series page whose episodes run as a thumbnail list beneath the artwork.

themes.name: Onyx
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Nuvio look: white on near-black, a full-bleed hero with a View details pill, a floating pill nav, stadium buttons.

themes.name: Orchid
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: A violet living-room palette: cool-black canvas, purple accent, landscape resume cards and a split series page. Pair with true black on OLED.

themes.name: Pocket
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Built for Steam Deck-class handhelds: L1/R1 section tabs, button prompts, big legible type and focus captions.

themes.name: Prism
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Cinematic glass. A tall rotating backdrop with a frosted caption card and a cyan halo, a top navigation bar, large rounded poster rails, wide resume stills with glass captions, and a full-bleed series page with an episode carousel of rounded stills.

themes.name: Reel
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: animepahe look: black and magenta, a text-link header, a latest-releases grid, its player page with the settings bar.

themes.name: Saffron
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Crunchyroll look: black and orange DM Sans, a key-art carousel with title logos, a Categories menu and episode grids.

themes.name: Slate
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: AniZone look: slate and rose in Figtree, text-link top bar, a newest poster row, episode stills, tag cards.

themes.name: Spotlight
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Anikoto look: navy and sky blue in Nunito, a full-width hero with Play now, sub-count posters, Top anime aside.

themes.name: Starlight
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Disney+ look: a glass top bar, a full-bleed hero with a trailer, poster rows with a white focus ring, a genre band and a tabbed series page; a side-rail TV layout with a grid keyboard.

themes.name: Tangerine
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Streaming-service orange on charcoal with square corners. A compact top bar, a tall featured backdrop with a bold Start Watching button, tight poster rows, and a stacked series page whose episodes are a grid of 16:9 stills with numbered titles.

themes.name: Tidal
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Living-room layout: a full-bleed featured backdrop with a large title, compact top navigation, and poster rows with titles and years. The series page paints Play, title, synopsis and chips directly on the artwork. Episodes sit below as wide stills.

themes.name: Volt
themes.author: Izumi
themes.description: Re:Anime look: black and lime in Inter, a full-bleed hero with skewed buttons, trending ranks in each cover's colour.
